purpose: Preserve complementary provider-authored conversation-state records and operational absence states in one bounded, inspectable handoff without deterministic semantic inference.

complete.meaning: The declared reader surface completed and has at least one admitted explicit record.

completed_zero.meaning: The declared reader completed and returned zero admitted records; this does not assert that the underlying semantic matter is absent.

partial.meaning: At least one explicit record is available, but the declared reader or source-run boundary did not complete.

failed.meaning: A preserved operational, schema, custody, dependency, or budget failure stopped the declared reader boundary.

missing.meaning: The planned reader result is unavailable or the reader contract does not exist; this never means a semantic zero.

machine_issue_codes.human_detail_policy: safe_detail is explanatory text only. Deterministic behavior must use the explicit state and controlled machine code and must never parse safe_detail. Raw provider errors and private identifiers are excluded.

bounds.bound_rationale: This v1 contract permits up to two complementary readers per required surface and leaves material headroom above the measured V1 role-record and source-locator loads. Larger designs require a new measured contract rather than silent expansion.

mechanical_outputs: exact payload and source-alias overlap pair counts
forbidden_deterministic_actions: infer a semantic role from prose, keywords, chronology, turn count, or array order
fill a failed or missing reader with a guessed semantic record
treat completed_zero as proof that the underlying matter is absent
merge or delete records because their prose or source aliases overlap
decide whether a relationship is meaningful merely because exact endpoint IDs resolve
decide graph relevance, pressure activation, advice quality, or trust
turn fan-in counts or coverage into a scalar score or quality badge

required_positive_paths: all six surfaces complete with explicit relationship endpoints
partial records remain visible beside a mechanical issue
failed and missing readers remain separately inspectable
two complementary readers may cite the same source alias without deletion
required_adversarial_paths: unknown state or issue code fails
payload, source, artifact, or self-hash drift fails
record surface differing from planned reader fails
relationship endpoint not present in admitted records fails
duplicate reader or record identity fails
record or byte bound overflow fails

expected_changed_measurement: A downstream consumer can inspect each planned reader's explicit records and operational state, and a missing reader can no longer masquerade as a completed semantic zero or deterministic stand-down evidence.
non_claims: not proof that any semantic payload is correct or sufficiently grounded
not proof that system-level conversation coverage is complete
not graph-value, pressure-value, answer-quality, decision-quality, or trust evidence
not authorization for a provider call
